The '''2015–16 Czech First League''', known as the '''[[Synot liga]]''' for sponsorship reasons, was the 23rd season of the [[Czech Republic]]'s top-tier [[Association football|football]] league. Defending champions [[FC Viktoria Plzeň|Viktoria Plzeň]] won the league for a second consecutive season, winning their fourth Czech title as a result.

==Teams==
[[Sigma Olomouc]], the [[2014–15 Czech National Football League|2014–15 FNL]] champion, returned to the First League just one season after their relegation. Runner-up [[FK Varnsdorf]] were not promoted as their stadium failed to meet the league requirements. Instead, [[FC Fastav Zlín]] rejoined the top level for the first time since the 2008–09 season.
